summary: No change: submission.json holds only the rationale and adds no sources, investigations, knowledge, gaps, interpretations or experiment; the bytes validate with no diagnostics. The run is at its budget limit and its record already stands complete for this session - all questions explained with retained receipts or an explicit source-only basis, no necessary gap open, every execution interpreted, and the findings with counterevidence plus sourced mechanism entries retained. A further experiment could not receive the interpretation that makes it evidence and more sourced entries would repeat recorded code, so the update remains unchanged; expiry preserves the retained work and needs no closing call, leaving defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication to human offline review.
